note: Task decomposition of docs/implementation-plan.md. Each task has an evidence-based acceptance. 'evidence' field lists the concrete proof stored under the task's evidence/ folder. env=live means it requires the user's real Teams tenant/phone and cannot be produced headlessly by the agent; env=local means fully verifiable here.

tasks.title: Node + TypeScript project scaffold with build/typecheck/test harness
tasks.spec: Initialize an independent TeamBot Node/TypeScript project (package.json, tsconfig, npm scripts: build, typecheck, test). Add a test runner (node --test or vitest) and a trivial passing test to prove the harness runs.
tasks.acceptance: npm run typecheck passes with 0 errors; npm test runs and reports at least 1 passing test; npm run build produces output.

tasks.title: Pin & generate Codex app-server protocol schema; verify method/event names
tasks.spec: Using codex-cli 0.156.1, generate the app-server JSON/TS schema. Commit the generated artifact. Add a test asserting the method names the architecture depends on (initialize, thread/start, thread/resume, turn/start, turn/steer, turn/interrupt) and key event names exist in the generated schema.
tasks.acceptance: Generated schema file committed; test asserts each required method/event name is present (or documents the real name if different, updating docs).

tasks.title: SQLite storage layer (inbox, outbox, jobs, approvals) with migrations
tasks.spec: Implement a storage module over SQLite with schema/migrations for inbox, outbox, jobs, approvals, events, pairings. Transactional writes.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests cover create/read/update for each table and a transactional multi-write; tests pass.

tasks.title: Inbox dedup and pairing baseline
tasks.spec: Dedup incoming messages by (tenant/account, chatId, messageId); establish baseline at first pairing so history is not executed; edited old messages do not trigger new jobs.
tasks.acceptance: Tests: same message read twice -> dispatched once; message before baseline -> ignored; edited old message -> no new job.

tasks.title: !tb command parser and ID naming (T/A/Q)
tasks.spec: Fixed parser for !tb commands (help, projects, run, status, continue, steer, stop, approve, deny, answer, result). Case-insensitive prefix normalization. ID naming per architecture (T=job, A=approval, Q=question).
tasks.acceptance: Parser unit tests cover every command, malformed input, and that a [TB ...] report line is NOT parsed as a command.

tasks.title: Router: identity check, allowlist, per-conversation binding, permission table
tasks.spec: Route only verified !tb messages. Enforce group member allowlist, per-conversation binding, and the §5 permission table (start/query/continue-stop/approve-answer/admin).
tasks.acceptance: Tests from the plan's verification table: group general chat & unauthorized member -> no dispatch; query self-chat jobId from group -> no private content; same display name different ID -> no permission; unregistered project -> no Codex start.

tasks.title: Codex app-server stdio adapter (initialize/thread/turn/steer/interrupt)
tasks.spec: Client that spawns codex app-server over stdio, performs initialize/initialized handshake, thread/start & thread/resume, turn/start, reads item/turn events, turn/steer with expectedTurnId, turn/interrupt, and answers approval/input requests.
tasks.acceptance: Integration test performs a real handshake against codex-cli 0.156.1 in an isolated temp dir and observes at least one turn lifecycle; interrupt is honored. (Falls back to documented skip with reason if codex not available at runtime.)

tasks.title: Supervisor: job state machine, single active turn, queue, project lock
tasks.spec: Job lifecycle (queued->starting->running->completed/failed, waiting_input/waiting_approval, stopping->cancelled, interrupted/unknown). One active turn per thread. Global single-job MVP with explicit queueing; project lock scaffold.
tasks.acceptance: State-machine tests cover all transitions and illegal transitions; concurrent submissions from self-chat and group -> correct queue order, results routed to source.

tasks.title: Progress coalescing and transactional outbox
tasks.spec: Coalesce progress events (<=1 per 30s guidance), segment long messages with jobId/seq/part, transactional outbox with 'send status unknown' retention; no exactly-once claim.
tasks.acceptance: Tests: bursty events coalesced; long message segmented; send-uncertain kept in outbox for reconciliation.

tasks.title: Playwright Teams adapter against a local fixture page
tasks.spec: Playwright adapter that reads new messages, confirms conversation identity, serializes sends and reconciles results — driven against a local HTML fixture emulating the Teams DOM (stable chat/message/sender IDs).
tasks.acceptance: Playwright test against the fixture: reads a new message, extracts (chatId, messageId, senderId), sends a reply, reconciles it. Serialized single-writer verified.

tasks.title: Electron Browser Host (isolated Teams WebContentsView)
tasks.spec: Port the isolated WebContentsView + persistent partition + login popup + view ownership design from ../codex-chatgpt-web (preserve MIT notices). No preload/Node integration for the remote page. Loopback-only control endpoint.
tasks.acceptance: Launcher builds; a smoke test starts the shell, loads the fixture/login URL in the isolated view, and confirms no Node integration is exposed to the page.

tasks.title: Phase 1 end-to-end: help/projects/run/status/result with fixtures
tasks.spec: Wire inbox+router+adapter+store+outbox with mock Teams fixture and mock/real Codex. Implement help, projects, run, status, result. Single running job.
tasks.acceptance: Integration test: one fixture phone message creates exactly one job; Codex runs in the registered project; status queryable; completion/failure returned to the source conversation.

tasks.title: Phase 2 interactive control: continue/steer/stop/approve/deny/answer
tasks.spec: Add continue, steer, stop, approve, deny, answer with idempotent inbox, duplicate/expired approval handling, stop-vs-actually-stopped distinction, approval codes bound per §5.
tasks.acceptance: Tests: mid-run query/steer/answer; wrong-source/expired approval rejected without affecting the turn; stopping vs cancelled distinguished; dangerous-op approval routed to self-chat.

tasks.title: Phase 3 restart/reconnect/checkpoint recovery
tasks.spec: Teams re-login, browser reload, checkpoint recovery; outbox reconciliation, send-status-unknown, process-loss, approval-wait recovery; offline recovery notice (arch §7).
tasks.acceptance: Tests: restart does not re-run history nor misroute results; unrecoverable jobs clearly marked; Teams offline but job done -> result held in outbox, reconciled on recovery.

tasks.title: Data retention/deletion and secret hygiene (arch §8)
tasks.spec: Implement TTL-based retention for audit/approval/cache/jobs, batch delete per conversation/job, and ensure logs/diagnostics exclude token/cookie/full env.
tasks.acceptance: Tests: expired records purged per TTL; batch delete removes a job's approvals/events/cache; log redaction verified.

tasks.title: Desktop console: project registration, pairing, status page, tray, explicit quit
tasks.spec: Desktop UI to register project aliases (normalized paths), pair conversations, member allowlist, per-job initiator, status page, tray minimize, explicit quit coordinating running jobs.
tasks.acceptance: UI build passes; component/logic tests for project registration path normalization and pairing baseline; manual-run instructions documented.

tasks.title: Windows install package, settings docs, redacted diagnostics export
tasks.spec: Produce a Windows installer/package, settings documentation, and a redacted diagnostics export.
tasks.acceptance: Packaging script runs and produces an artifact; diagnostics export verified free of secrets.

tasks.title: Phase 0 LIVE: real tenant login, stable IDs, dual-surface, phone push (user-run)
tasks.spec: Provide a guided harness + checklist for the user to run against their real Teams tenant: verify login/conditional access, stable chat/message/sender IDs, self-chat + one group dual-surface, background updates, reply targeting, same-account phone push behavior. Record go/no-go with fallback per plan.
tasks.acceptance: User executes the harness and records results in evidence/results.md (go/no-go + which capabilities verified/blocked). Agent cannot self-verify (requires live tenant + phone; real Teams sends restricted per AGENTS.md).
